name: Learn by bowing, asking and serving
meaning: Knowledge is gained by approaching those who have seen the truth with humility, questions and service; it is not easily understood from an ordinary teacher.
applies_when: Someone needs guidance on a skill, a decision or a spiritual question and is trying to work it out alone.
misleads_when: It is used to demand blind obedience or to put a teacher beyond question. Viveka never treats any guru as beyond scrutiny.
modern_application: Find one person who has done what you are trying to do. Prepare three good questions and ask for their time.

name: Some understanding does not come by argument alone
meaning: The deepest understanding is not reached by reasoning alone; it is grasped when taught and when affirmed, not merely debated.
applies_when: Someone is stuck in endless intellectual debate about meaning and getting no closer.
misleads_when: It is used to dismiss evidence, critical thinking or fair questions.
modern_application: Alongside thinking about the question, try living as if one answer were true for a month, and see what you learn.

name: Reflect fully, then choose for yourself
meaning: After teaching everything, Krishna tells Arjuna: 'Reflect on it fully, then do as you choose.' The final decision is the person's own.
applies_when: Someone has gathered advice and must now decide, or is being pressured to decide someone else's way.
misleads_when: It is used to dismiss all guidance and tradition as irrelevant.
modern_application: Write the options, what each would cost and give, and what your conscience says. Then decide, and own the decision.

name: Faith steadies; corrosive doubt paralyses
meaning: One with faith and self-control gains knowledge and peace; for one consumed by doubt there is neither this world nor the next.
applies_when: Someone is so caught in second-guessing that they cannot act on anything.
misleads_when: It is used to shame honest questions. Nachiketas's persistent questioning is praised in the Katha.
modern_application: Separate the doubts you can resolve by finding something out from those you can only settle by committing. Act on the second kind.

name: Hold on to the question that matters
meaning: Offered every pleasure to drop his question about what lies beyond death, Nachiketas refuses: no other teacher equals Death, and no other boon equals this one.
applies_when: Someone is being distracted or bought off from pursuing what truly matters to them.
misleads_when: It turns into stubbornness about a question that has been answered.
modern_application: Write down your most important unanswered question. Protect one hour a week for it, even when easier things call.

name: Turn down the tempting substitute
meaning: Nachiketas weighs long life, wealth, power and pleasure, finds them fleeting, and lets them go; Death praises him for not taking the chain of wealth in which many sink.
applies_when: Someone is offered money, comfort or status to give up something they value: integrity, a calling, a relationship.
misleads_when: It is used to turn down genuinely good opportunities, or to romanticise hardship.
modern_application: Ask of the offer: in five years, which choice will I be glad I made? Then ask someone who knows you well the same question.

name: Nothing purifies like knowledge
meaning: As fire turns wood to ash, the fire of knowledge burns up the past; nothing in this world purifies like it.
applies_when: Someone feels stuck in the consequences of past mistakes and wants a fresh start.
misleads_when: It is used to skip making amends for harm done.
modern_application: Write down what you have understood from the mistake that you did not understand before. That understanding is the new start.

name: To know it is to know you do not fully know it
meaning: The Kena student says: 'I do not think I know it well; yet it is not that I do not know it.' It is unknown to those who claim to know it.
applies_when: Someone is anxious because they cannot be certain about the big questions.
misleads_when: It becomes a reason never to act.
modern_application: Let 'I don't fully know, and I can still live well' be enough for today.

name: Different paths reach the same goal
meaning: Knowledge and action are not truly opposed: the state reached by one is reached by the other, and some reach it by meditation, some by knowledge, some by action, some by hearing.
applies_when: Family members argue about the 'right' way to live a spiritual or ethical life.
misleads_when: It is used to deny that some paths suit some people far better than others.
modern_application: Ask what path fits your temperament and life now: study, service, meditation or devotion. Start there without disparaging others.

name: Let tested guidance inform what you do
meaning: One who sets aside the guidance of scripture and acts on impulse gains neither perfection nor happiness; let it guide what should and should not be done.
applies_when: Someone is acting purely on impulse in a weighty matter.
misleads_when: It becomes literalism, or is used to enforce excluded or harmful rules. The Gita itself warns against clinging to the letter.
modern_application: Before a weighty decision, check it against one source of tested wisdom you trust, not only your mood.

name: Go beyond the letter
meaning: The unwise delight in the letter of scripture and say there is nothing more; to one who knows, all the Vedas are like a well when water floods everywhere.
applies_when: Rules are being applied rigidly in a way that defeats their purpose.
misleads_when: It is used to discard all discipline or tradition as 'mere letter'.
modern_application: For a rule you are struggling with, ask what it is for, and whether there is a way to honour that purpose here.

name: Wisdom is lost unless it is passed on
meaning: The ancient teaching was handed down from teacher to student; over a long span of time it was lost, and had to be taught again.
applies_when: An elder or experienced person wonders whether to pass on what they know.
misleads_when: It is used to insist that only one lineage holds the truth.
modern_application: Teach one thing you know well to one younger person this month.

name: Sharing understanding with care
meaning: The teaching is shared with those who are willing to listen; Krishna gives it to Arjuna 'because you are my friend', and the Kena teacher confirms it has been given in full.
applies_when: Someone wants to share what has helped them, and is unsure how or with whom.
misleads_when: It turns into preaching to people who have not asked.
modern_application: Share what helped you only when asked, and in the form of your own experience, not instructions.

name: Clear understanding knows when to act and when to refrain
meaning: Clear (sattvic) understanding knows when to act and when to refrain, what to fear and what not, what binds and what frees; confused understanding takes wrong for right.
applies_when: A morally unclear situation, where the person cannot tell right from wrong.
misleads_when: It is used to label people who disagree as 'deluded'.
modern_application: Write the decision as four questions: should I act now or wait? What is truly to be feared here? What would bind me? What would free me?
